test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Nov, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All trees are branches.

Some branches are leaves.

Conclusions:

(I) All leaves are branches.

(II) All leave are trees.
solution:
The least possible venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cc2cea5872366acb4226c45fb09e32d2f226c3a0227640afb6d050c063822f7a.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3cb052862c250564d89b4fe60962897a45f136c6d7b723ce0155751e9a85986b.png] 

**Conclusions:**

(I) All leaves are branches → False( As, All trees are branches and Some branches are leaves. so, All leaves are branches can be a possibility, but not definite) 

(II) All leave are trees → False( As, there is no direct relation between leaves and trees. so, All leaves are tress can be a possibility, but not definite)

Thus, Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
